PAYMENT_TEMPLATE.TITLE: Payment confirmation template
PAYMENT_TEMPLATE.HINT: WhatsApp delivers only approved templates to a patient who last wrote more than 24 hours ago. Pick the template that confirms a Mercado Pago payment in that case; inside the window the patient gets the usual text.

PAYMENTS.TITLE: Payments
PAYMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Mercado Pago charges the AI Brain made for patients, newest first. A paid appointment the patient cancelled waits here for you to decide on a refund.
PAYMENTS.CONFIRM_REFUND: Return {amount} to {patient} through Mercado Pago? This cannot be undone.
